overall_summary: Analysis of 25 Shorts reveals that time-bound global cataclysms ('5 seconds' or 'same second' events) and dramatic planetary visuals (Saturn rings) generate the highest retention (>50-63% average percentage watched) and view counts (600-1000+ views). Abstract visual/micro concepts (e.g., seeing Wi-Fi signals) perform poorly (<20% retention). Main growth levers are immediate action hooks in the first 0.05 progress mark and maintaining high relative retention through time-limited consequences.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' achieved 862 studio views, 63.11% avg view percentage, and 38s avg duration. 'What If All Lightning Struck At The Same Second?' reached 52.71% avg view percentage and 32s avg duration.
what_is_working.action: Frame scenarios around brief, highly disruptive duration limits (e.g., 3 to 10 seconds) with immediate visual stakes.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' gained 1059 studio views with 50.79% average view percentage and 30s avg view duration.
what_is_working.action: Focus visual hooks on large-scale planetary sky changes visible from daily ground perspectives.

what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If You Could See Every Wi-Fi Signal?' generated only 5 studio views and 17.67% avg view percentage; 'What If Water Turned Into Liquid Mercury?' generated only 19 views.
what_to_improve.action: Avoid non-cinematic or invisible micro-phenomena; keep topics grounded in immediate, high-contrast environmental impact.

what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If Rain Fell at the Speed of a Bullet?' drops to 0.1488 relative retention by 0.05 video progress despite a strong initial premise.
what_to_improve.action: Replace long introductory voiceovers with instant high-speed visual simulations within 0.01 to 0.03 progress.

retention_insights.evidence: 'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' maintains an audience watch ratio of 0.7285 at 0.26 progress and relative retention above 0.50 throughout.
retention_insights.action: Structure pacing to deliver step-by-step escalations of each second during the event.

retention_insights.evidence: 'What If Oceans Froze From the Bottom Up?' drops from 0.4355 relative retention at 0.01 progress to 0.2232 at 0.10 progress.
retention_insights.action: Deliver a fast visual payoff before 0.05 progress to lock in early viewers before explaining ocean dynamics.

best_posting_windows.reason: Highest performing individual uploads ('What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' at 04:56 UTC with 1059 views; 'What If Sound Could Travel Through Space?' at 04:47 UTC with 663 views) were published in this slot.
Top retention performer ('What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' at 12:08 UTC with 862 views and 63.11% retention) was published in this slot.

avoid_or_limit.reason: Topics like seeing Wi-Fi signals yielded under 20% average view percentage and extremely low views.
Posting identical titles twice within seconds (e.g., Earth Had Rings at 04:55:51 vs 04:56:06) splits performance and algorithm distribution.
